items.title: Castle said he was most impressed with Wemby defensive effort (9 blocks, 5 in the first half):
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Castle said he was most impressed with Wemby defensive effort (9 blocks, 5 in the first half):

"I think that's what kind of started everything, got him really into rhythm and opened up the game for us, opened up our lead and made everybody start playing free."
